annotations.title: Product prices, history and price check

description: Everything about one product: each shop's current price and stock, the cheapest shop, the 90-day price history (lowest, highest, usual, last change) and a plain verdict on whether today's price is a good one, plus key specs and a few alternatives. Use before recommending a purchase. Accepts the product url or slug from search_products, or a product name.
